modified_caption: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, employing SnapKV as the pruning method with a KV cache budget of 1/64. The line plot depicts relative change across five layer groupings (Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, Layer29-32) on the x-axis, with the y-axis representing relative change from -25% to 5%. The yellow line (LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit) remains approximately stable near 0% throughout, exhibiting a minor dip to roughly -3% at Layer13-20 before stabilizing. The red line (LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit) demonstrates a gradual decline, reaching nearly -10% at Layer13-20, then recovering to approximately -2% by Layer29-32. The light blue line (RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit) declines sharply to -18% at Layer13-20, subsequently rebounding to around -5% by Layer29-32. The dark blue line (RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit) collapses to -25% at Layer13-20, then rapidly recovers to -8% by Layer29-32. The gray dashed baseline (4×tokens, 4-bit) remains constant at 0% across all layers. Notably, the RULER4k configurations consistently underperform relative to LB-Avg configurations, with the 8-bit variants exhibiting more pronounced volatility than their 16-bit counterparts across middle layers.

modifications.claim: The red line (LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit) demonstrates a gradual decline, reaching nearly -10% at Layer13-20.
modifications.reality: The red line actually dips to approximately -5% at Layer13-20, not -10%. The decline is also not gradual but rather a small, consistent dip.

modifications.claim: The light blue line (RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit) declines sharply to -18% at Layer13-20.
modifications.reality: The light blue line declines to roughly -12% at Layer13-20, not -18%. The characterization of the decline as 'sharp' is exaggerated but directionally correct.

modifications.claim: The dark blue line (RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit) rapidly recovers to -8% by Layer29-32.
modifications.reality: The dark blue line recovers to approximately -4% by Layer29-32, not -8%. The rate of recovery is also not as rapid as implied.

correct_elements: Chart type is correctly identified as a line plot.
Axis labels (Layer and Relative Change) and their groupings are accurate.
The yellow line (LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit) is correctly described as stable near 0%.
The gray dashed baseline (4×tokens, 4-bit) is correctly noted as constant at 0%.
The general trend of decline and recovery in the middle layers for RULER4k configurations is directionally correct.
The KV cache budget and pruning method (SnapKV) are correctly stated.
